answer: Joining requires an escrow bond paid out only after proven work locked as a slashable bond: identity becomes a paid commitment. The network catches signing two conflicting attestations in one epoch through comparing signatures on the ledger. When the proof lands, repeat offences inside sixteen epochs double the slash each time. Think of the bond as a bridge: locked, visible, forfeitable. Every beacon is audited against the bond registry each epoch. Without a zephyr of fresh stake, a new identity cannot register.
